sender.bs: „Kupac“ sa OLX.ba koji se javlja na Viber ili WhatsApp
sender.en: A “buyer” from OLX.ba who gets in touch on Viber or WhatsApp

name.bs: Lažni kupac na OLX.ba: „već sam platio, preuzmite novac na linku“
name.en: Fake OLX.ba buyer: “I’ve already paid, collect the money at the link”

how.bs: Prodajete nešto na OLX.ba i javlja se „kupac“, pa razgovor brzo prebacuje na Viber, WhatsApp ili SMS. Tvrdi da je artikal već platio preko kurira ili pošte i šalje link da „preuzmete uplatu“. Stranica liči na OLX.ba, BH Poštu ili kurirsku službu i traži sve podatke kartice, uključujući CVC. Umjesto da primite novac, prevaranti ga skinu sa vašeg računa.
how.en: You are selling something on OLX.ba and a “buyer” gets in touch, then quickly moves the chat to Viber, WhatsApp or text. They say they’ve already paid through a courier or the post and send a link so you can “collect the payment”. The page looks like OLX.ba, BH Pošta or a courier and asks for all your card details, including the CVC. Instead of receiving money, the scammers take it from your account.

text.bs: „Kupac“ odmah želi razgovarati van OLX-a, na Viberu ili WhatsAppu.
text.en: The “buyer” immediately wants to talk off OLX, on Viber or WhatsApp.

text.bs: Kaže da je već platio preko kurira i šalje link.
text.en: They say they’ve already paid through a courier and send a link.

text.bs: Stranica traži broj kartice, datum i CVC „za primanje novca“.
text.en: The page asks for your card number, expiry date and CVC “to receive the money”.

text.bs: Požuruje: kurir samo čeka vašu potvrdu.
text.en: They hurry you: the courier is only waiting for your confirmation.

text.bs: Pozdrav, uzimam artikal bez pregovaranja. Platio sam odmah preko brze dostave, kurir dolazi po paket sutra. Da vam se novac prebaci na karticu, samo potvrdite podatke ovdje: [link]
text.en: Hi, I’ll take the item without haggling. I paid right away through express delivery, the courier will collect the parcel tomorrow. To get the money moved to your card, just confirm your details here: [link]

bs: olx kupac poslao link za uplatu
kupac kaže da je već platio preko kurira
prodavao na olx skinuli mi novac
lažna stranica brze pošte za preuzimanje novca
en: olx buyer sent a payment link
buyer says they already paid through a courier
asked for my cvc to receive money
sold on olx and money was taken from my account
buyer moved the chat to viber
fake delivery page to collect the money

bs: Za primanje novca dovoljan je broj računa (IBAN); CVC služi samo za plaćanje.
OLX.ba ne traži podatke kartice ni plaćanje unaprijed.
Prebacivanje razgovora sa OLX-a na Viber ili WhatsApp.
Stranica sa čudnim prijevodom ili mješavinom jezika.
en: To receive money an account number (IBAN) is enough; the CVC is only for paying.
OLX.ba doesn’t ask for card details or payment in advance.
Moving the chat from OLX to Viber or WhatsApp.
A page with odd translation or mixed languages.

bs: Ne otvarajte link i ne upisujte podatke kartice.
Dopisujte se samo kroz OLX poruke i prijavite korisnika OLX podršci.
Ako ste unijeli podatke, odmah zovite banku radi blokade i prijavite policiji (122).
en: Don’t open the link or enter card details.
Only chat through OLX messages and report the user to OLX support.
If you entered details, call your bank at once to block the card and report it to the police (122).

sources.title: Drastičan porast online prevara u BiH, napadači koriste vještačku inteligenciju da vam otmu novac
